note: Identity-only capture for the T-72, the Soviet main battle tank family. The entry names the family and no mark: it publishes no figure, carries no alias and claims no member. The identity evidence is the engine class table, which declares the RHS T-72B3 and T-72B classes and the RHSSAF T-72MS class with display names that carry the T-72 designation. The grade is claimed, because the source is the engine class table. That is the form data/vehicle/class_map.json records as aee_class_table: identity evidence only, never a figure. No document citation is invented and no sources.json record is created. The keyword holds the family designation the display names carry. A mark entry must not claim it: the family owns it, and the family rung alone reads it.
